study.title: LTIF 2026
study.subtitle: The website for a free two-day forum in Accra for founders, investors and policymakers, designed in Figma and built with Claude.
study.overview: LTIF 2026 is the website for the Loveworld Trade & Investment Forum, held at the Ohene Konadu Auditorium, UPSA, Accra on October 6–7. Five pages (Home, Speakers, Schedule, About and Contact) share one header, menu, footer and motion layer. I designed the base in Figma, then used Claude to finish the build and fine-tune every motion. In seven days the site had 13K unique page views, 16K visits and 4K+ online registrations, and 2K+ people came to the forum in person.

accordion.title: Challenge
accordion.body: The 2025 forum drew 1,700+ attendees. The 2026 edition needed one site that filled seats, brought in sponsors and kept a speaker list and agenda current while they were still changing days before the event.

accordion.title: Approach
accordion.body: Every action points to one free registration on Tix Africa. The site reuses the forum's own imagery (2025 event photography cut into circles), and the ticket becomes the main call-to-action shape.

accordion.title: Process
accordion.body: The layout was designed in Figma on a 1920px artboard. Claude turned it into code, where every measurement is a multiple of one design pixel, so the page scales proportionally from phone to 4K. Then came the motion pass: GSAP, ScrollTrigger and Lenis.

accordion.title: Impact
accordion.body: 13K unique page views, 16K visits and 4K+ registrations in seven days, and 2K+ people in the room in Accra.

blocks.heading: NAVY, SIGNAL YELLOW AND ONE CURVE.
blocks.body: One bezier from the Figma file joins every section. Scalloped ticket edges mark anything you can act on. Every photo is a circle crop, so people come first. Headlines rise word by word out of a mask.
